<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
<title>Clever Turtle 2</title>
<style>
/* From Uiverse.io by Praashoo7 - https://uiverse.io/Praashoo7/clever-turtle-2 */
/* From Uiverse.io by Praashoo7 - Tags: brown, button, stitched */
button {
  outline: none;
  color: #DAA06D;
  padding: 1em;
  padding-left: 3em;
  padding-right: 3em;
  border: 2px dashed #DAA06D;
  border-radius: 15px;
  background-color: #EADDCA;
  box-shadow: 0 0 0 4px #EADDCA, 2px 2px 4px 2px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.5);
  transition: .1s ease-in-out, .4s color;
}

button:active {
  transform: translateX(0.1em) translateY(0.1em);
  box-shadow: 0 0 0 4px #EADDCA, 1.5px 1.5px 2.5px 1.5px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.5);
}
</style>
</head>
<body>
<button>
  BUTTON
</button>
